title: Potatoes Stuffed with Mushroom Duxelles
subtitle: with walnuts and Roquefort
description: Par-boiled potato halves are hollowed out and filled with a mushroom, walnut, celery and Roquefort mixture, topped with cream and baked until golden.

steps.text: Boil the potatoes for about 8 minutes from when the water boils, just until they begin to soften. Drain and cool.
Halve the potatoes and scoop out the flesh with a melon baller or small spoon, leaving walls 2 cm thick. Drizzle 1/2 tsp melted butter into each half.

Fry the chopped onions in the remaining butter until golden. When soft, add the garlic and chopped mushrooms (with the soaked, chopped shiitake), saute, and season with salt and pepper. You can prepare up to this point ahead and refrigerate.
Mix the sauteed filling with the toasted chopped walnuts, chopped celery, herbs and crumbled Roquefort.
Fill each potato boat with the mixture and pour a little cream over the top. Bake for about 15 minutes, until the top is golden.
